Q1.rationale: Segment 72(a) requires the Recipient to promptly notify, to the extent practicable, before disclosing under governmental, judicial or regulatory request.
Q1.label: Entailment

Q2.rationale: No segment mentions sexual harassment or sexual assault; the confidentiality duties are general and the NDA does not deal with this disclosure.
Q2.label: NotMentioned

Q3.rationale: Segment 38 permits disclosure to directors, officers, employees, agents or representatives who have a need to know.
Q3.label: Entailment

Q4.rationale: Segment 60 bars duplication of tangible Confidential Information except for purposes of the Agreement, which implies copying is allowed in some circumstances.
Q4.label: Entailment

Q5.rationale: Segment 38 allows sharing with agents and representatives, and segment 40 excepts other third-party disclosures provided for herein; consultants and advisors are not named but fall within agents or representatives.
Q5.label: Entailment

Q6.rationale: Segment 78(b) keeps the duty of confidence for information disclosed during the term in effect indefinitely, and segment 75 imposes a 24-month post-termination restriction.
Q6.label: Entailment

Q7.rationale: No non-solicitation covenant appears; segment 75 is a non-competition restriction only.
Q7.label: NotMentioned

Q8.rationale: Segment 61 bars disclosure of Confidential Information or any dispute to any government agency or regulator without consent, and the only carve-outs (35, 72) cover legally required disclosure, not voluntary whistleblower reports.
Q8.label: Contradiction

Q9.rationale: Segment 25 covers information in tangible or intangible form, whenever and however disclosed, which includes verbally conveyed information.
Q9.label: Entailment

Q10.rationale: Segment 46 states that no other right or license in the Confidential Information is granted to the Parties.
Q10.label: Entailment

Q11.rationale: No immunity notice for trade secret disclosure to government officials or attorneys appears in the NDA.
Q11.label: NotMentioned

Q12.rationale: Segment 25 defines Confidential Information by nature and not by marking, so no express identification requirement exists and the definition is incompatible with one.
Q12.label: Contradiction

Q13.rationale: Segment 67 carves out information received from a third party without breach, which permits acquiring such information outside the restrictions.
Q13.label: Entailment

Q14.rationale: Segment 54 bars manufacturing or testing any product embodying Confidential Information, which restricts reverse engineering in substance but not by that name.
Q14.label: Entailment

Q15.rationale: Segment 83 provides for recovery of costs and fees, and no fixed sum or penalty is stated.
Q15.label: NotMentioned

Q16.rationale: No notice of the trade secret whistleblower immunity appears in the NDA.
Q16.label: NotMentioned

Q17.rationale: Segment 45 limits use of Confidential Information solely to the Transaction and forbids other purposes without consent.
Q17.label: Entailment

Q18.rationale: No fixed penalty or liquidated damages provision appears; segment 83 provides only for costs and fees.
Q18.label: NotMentioned

Q19.rationale: Segment 29 lists personal identifiable information as Confidential Information, segment 45 limits its use to the Transaction, and segment 39 requires reasonable care in protecting it.
Q19.label: Entailment
